So, the two year anniversary of my best male friend "dumping" me (for lack of a better word) is coming up. And it's something that I've never been able to resolve to my satisfaction.

The basics are this: I come from a childhood and family full of physical, mental, and emotional abuse that was primarily religiously motivated. And lived with the whole cycle of abuse thing. Growing up, I didn't have any friends and was isolated from people my own age. It wasn't until I secretly moved out/ran away during college that I started making friends. "X" was one of the first guy friends that I made, and we were really close friends for 3 years.

I was terribly awkward, introverted, and shy. I didn't know how to respond to most social cues, or how to react in social situations. It was even difficult to pick up on sarcasm. I was also terribly, terribly depressed. But he stuck with me, and was very patient, and I felt that I grew a lot as a person. I became close friends and roommates with his gf, and became friends with a lot of his friends.

Even after he graduated college, we still were close and hung out a lot. Then I finally graduated, and was preparing to move a pretty far distance for graduate school. He helped me move to temporary housing in the meantime. The last conversation we had was that he called asking if he left a rope at the place, because he couldn't find it. He hadn't. Strangely, after that. He stopped responding to my texts or phone calls. And his gf was super cagey about it, and wouldn't talk about it. His other friends either didn't know/pretended not to know.

So, I ended up moving to a new city, and losing the only group of friends that I ever had. The emotional shock was beyond overwhelming and was a contributing factor to me failing grad school.

So, two years later, and I'm doing a lot better. A lot better than I even would've imagined. But sometimes it still nags at me, and I wonder if it was something that I did. I just don't know. Does anyone have any advice about this? How to get past it? What to learn from it? Anything? I'd even like to hear your own stories of similar situations; maybe we can help each other out.
How to Get Over a Friend "Dumping" Me?
